summary: The candidate is a valid partial fix: it selects only requested native/Hugging Face MTP shards for recognized indexes and fixes the parent review's exact model.nextn.layers mixed-layout counterexample. It does not fully satisfy the original safe-fallback contract because other clearly draft-signaling unknown layouts, including model.mtp_layers.* already represented in this repository and model.nextn_predict_layers.*, are not classified as unknown. When mixed with a recognized requested-layer key, their shards are silently dropped instead of falling back to the complete prepared list.

tests.what_was_measured: Original failure reproduced: for a recognized native MTP index the exact list passed to runai_safetensors_weights_iterator contained all five prepared shards, including target and non-requested-layer shards. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-1de4e777e677/base-probe.txt.

Independently reproduced the parent review: the exact model.nextn.layers mixed index passed only draft-1.safetensors to RunAI and dropped the unknown draft shard. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-1de4e777e677/pr2946-probe.txt.

Candidate regression suite passed: 17 tests, 18 warnings, and 6 subtests. It covers recognized layouts, shared shards, cached object-storage metadata, incomplete/malformed indexes, and the reported mixed model.nextn.layers case. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-1de4e777e677/candidate-focused-pytest.txt.

The candidate pruned recognized-only input correctly and fell back for model.nextn.layers.*, but returned only draft-1.safetensors for mixed model.mtp_layers.* and model.nextn_predict_layers.* indexes, dropping the unknown draft shard. Raw output: /job/review-evidence-j-1de4e777e677/candidate-probe.txt.
Candidate patch has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect is deterministic JSON key classification and Python filename selection before tensor streaming; GPU numerical execution would not measure it. The prepared x86_64 environment exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015, but it was intentionally not used for an unrelated smoke.

remaining_counterexamples: An index containing mtp.1.decoder.weight plus model.mtp_layers.1.shared.weight, with every prepared filename represented, selects only the recognized requested-layer shard and drops the model.mtp_layers shard instead of falling back to all prepared shards.

An index containing mtp.1.decoder.weight plus model.nextn_predict_layers.1.shared.weight, with every prepared filename represented, selects only the recognized requested-layer shard and drops the nextn_predict_layers shard instead of falling back to all prepared shards.
remaining_limitations: No live object-storage credentials or production sharded MTP checkpoint were available, so provider header-read counts, distributed streaming, and end-to-end model semantics remain unverified.
No native source changed in the candidate (only Python source, tests, and reports), and repository-environment.json defines no native rebuild target; native rebuilding is not applicable.
The imported candidate source was /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/model_loader/loader.py under the pinned prepared interpreter, not an installed wheel copy.
The review establishes a source-level contract violation without model weights; it does not claim semantic accuracy for any MTP architecture.
